description: Use to SEE the screen (pixels: layout, colours, clipping). Returns an image item (PNG, also saved to file or ./crewdroid-<serial>-<time>.png) and a text line with path and size. To find a button or text to tap, use screen instead. On API 31 a fully black screen after an app relaunch (emulator bug, ADR 0005) is recovered first.
